Definition: (only in plural) a pistachio-nut (from its form)
BiblicalUsage: Pistachio nuts are the delicacy Jacob sends to Egypt, and the word appears once, in his parting gift. In Genesis 43:11 Jacob says, take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds. A father's present, sent with his sons to a ruler he does not know is his own son.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the nuts in Jacob's gift are a father's hope in a basket: the best of the land, sent to soften a stranger's heart.
